<div class="card-body">
'''WED15-I662 'Treadwell' Droid''' is a [[Dark]] [[Character]] from [[Premiere (Japanese)|Premiere (Japanese)]].
<nowiki />
<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">ＷＥＤ１５－Ｉ６６２ “トレッドウェル” ドロイド</span>
<h2>Card Text</h2>
<span lang="ja">同じ場所にいる自分のビークルとドロイドはすべて、耐：損耗＜２を得る。また、“トレッドウェル”ドロイドがドッキング・ベイにいるなら、同一星系にいる自分の宇宙戦闘機はすべて耐：損耗＜３を得る。</span><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-Premiere-1301-197o-Face.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].</ref>
<h2>Lore</h2>
''<span lang="ja">標準型のトレッドウェル・ドロイド。通称アイシックスシックストゥ。大型機械や宇宙戦闘機の補修などに数千体が稼動している。</span>''<ref name="jp-face" />
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' WED15-I662 “Treadwell” Droid.

'''Card text:''' All of your vehicles and droids at the same location gain immunity to attrition less than 2. If Treadwell Droid is at a docking bay, all your starfighters in the same system gain immunity to attrition less than 3.

'''Lore:''' A standard Treadwell droid nicknamed I-Six-Six-Two. Thousands are in service repairing heavy machinery and starfighters.
<h2>Notes</h2>
Japanese-language printing of [[WED15-I662 'Treadwell' Droid]] in [[Premiere (Japanese)]].<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 41, 97. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="jp-face" />
